title: The picture follows the connection
description: Serves "The picture follows the connection."; "The picture is as good as the device and the connection allow."; "Storage stays bounded.".
acceptanceCriteria: A title offers the original, always the best, and a few lighter versions below it, never larger than the film itself.
720p is the usual floor; 480p exists only for a film whose own picture is SD, or when nothing higher keeps it playing.
On Android TV and phones (and in the browser) the picture steps down and up with the connection while it plays, with no stall beyond a stated bound on a throttled link.
A manual pick holds until the viewer chooses automatic again.
One picture serves every audio language, so a language switch needs no new picture.
Lighter versions are made only when needed, within the budget, on local disk and S3; storage per film-hour is stated and shown per version.
Every capability it adds is in the published contract (JS-183) and passes its conformance check.
